provenance.membership_method: Each part of the State 2022 district layers is assigned to the one island whose reference extent (etl/islands.py) contains it; the result must equal the reviewed list. No county polygons are used.
provenance.coastline_method: Replayed unmodified; parts are assigned the same way, parts outside every extent (Northwestern Hawaiian Islands) are dropped; no simplification.
provenance.name_authority: Hawaiʻi Board on Geographic Names (HRS chapter 4E)

district_sources.method: ArcGIS server generalization: maxAllowableOffset=0.0005 degrees; outSR=4326; GeoJSON; source district IDs normalized without further geometry simplification.
